title: Codex out of credits is a classified limit, so the role falls back

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: 2026-10-26: hand relays S125 and S127 stopped when Codex printed 'ERROR: Your workspace is out of credits. Add credits to continue.' (.scratch/s127/impl/out1.txt:4724, text mode). The codex adapter classifies only 'You've hit your usage limit' and 429 rate_limit_exceeded as limited (internal/agent/codex/codex.go:194), so in ork this would fail the run instead of falling back to the next lineup row (adj 156: fallback only on classified rate limits).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestOutOfCreditsIsRateLimited: a turn.failed or error event whose message says the workspace is out of credits sets ExitRateLimited.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decision 2026-10-27 (interactive question): out of credits counts as a classified limit under adj 156 (yes). Match the message text "out of credits" (case-sensitive substring, as for "You've hit your usage limit") in turn.failed and error events and set limited. The JSON event shape is not recorded (the log was text mode): build the fixture from the existing turn.failed shape and mark it unverified in design.md and the test comment. Add the case to the table test near codex_test.go:258 and to the loop near :124. design.md: add the new text to the classified-limit sentence.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/agent/codex ./internal/engine; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
